title: hieracium incisum subsp. senile
intro: Hieracium incisum subsp. senile, commonly known as Alpine Hawk's-beard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation. The health benefits of Hieracium incisum subsp. senile include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
